description:
Implement Record-Level Security (RLS) on the 'demodb' database to restrict customer profile access by region. 

1. Create a new Role named 'RegionalManager' that extends the 'reader' role.
2. Create two new Users with password 'management_access' assigned to this role:
   - 'manager_eu'
   - 'manager_na'
3. Configure RLS on the 'Profiles' class using the '_allowRead' property so that:
   - 'manager_eu' can ONLY see profiles with European nationalities: Italian, German, French, Spanish, Dutch, British, Greek.
   - 'manager_na' can ONLY see profiles with North American nationalities: American, Canadian, Mexican, Brazilian.

Use the OrientDB Studio (http://localhost:2480/studio/index.html) with root credentials (root / GymAnything123!). You can use SQL commands like UPDATE to set the _allowRead property based on Nationality. The _allowRead property accepts a list of User RIDs (links).
